cypInteractions.switchingRelevance: Moderate CYP2D6 inhibition can elevate levels of co-prescribed CYP2D6 substrates. Levels of duloxetine itself are sensitive to CYP1A2 inhibitors (e.g. fluvoxamine — generally avoid co-administration). PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

discontinuationSyndromeRisk.notes: High risk of discontinuation symptoms; not as severe as venlafaxine but worse than the long-half-life SSRIs. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

formulationNotes: Delayed-release capsules. Cannot be split or crushed. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.
